legends: TCP_inuse - Tcp sockets currently in use

metrics.label: TCP_inuse - Tcp sockets currently in use

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_sockstat_TCP_alloc IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_sockstat_TCP_inuse IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_sockstat_TCP_orphan IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_sockstat_TCP_tw IS NOT NULL
| STATS TCP_alloc_Allocated_sockets = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_sockstat_TCP_alloc)), TCP_inuse_Tcp_sockets_currently_in_use = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_sockstat_TCP_inuse)), TCP_orphan_Orphan_sockets = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_sockstat_TCP_orphan)), TCP_tw_Sockets_waiting_close = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_sockstat_TCP_tw)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, TCP_alloc_Allocated_sockets, TCP_inuse_Tcp_sockets_currently_in_use, TCP_orphan_Orphan_sockets, TCP_tw_Sockets_waiting_close
| SORT time_bucket ASC
